notes.title: Rum Ram Update to Version 1.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Stability updates and fixes.[/b][/h2]

[b]New:[/b] Basic AI Framework.
[b]Patched:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused 'Text Chat' to not replicate to all users.
[b]Patched:[/b] Addressed a geometry exploit in map Small Bay.
[b]Patched:[/b] Sound FX Volumes.
[b]Improved:[/b] Game Acoustics.
[b]Improved:[/b] Online Matchmaking.
[b]Improved:[/b] Optimized Reflections.
[b]Improved:[/b] Optimized Geometry.
[b]Improved:[/b] Support for faster Texture Decompression.
[b]Improved:[/b] Local Exposure Post-Processing.
[b]Improved:[/b] Post-Motion Blur Translucency.

That's all for today's update. Our team is working on new updates which will focus on new content, optimization and translation of the game in several languages. Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Rum Ram Update to Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Major Features[/b][/h1]


[h3][b]New Map - Small Bay[/b][/h3]
Enjoy your battles somewhere in the Great Outer Sea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32295460/e6510eeab1294553375a33a1f62afdbebfbf9a98.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]New Mode - Training[/b][/h3]
This game mode lets you experiment with the ship's movement, attacks, damage points and pickable objects in a comfy safe space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32295460/896c9c9a3cac7d4892d5b0ca784c415705267e59.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]New Match Type - Competitive[/b][/h3]
The online game mode is now split to Regular and Ranked type of matches. For all of you that want to flex your rank to other people. Yes, we feel you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32295460/d7140b8c0a1aaf6e909be336c9b5bef9ceff2afa.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]New Menu - Experience and Rank[/b][/h3]
There is now a new UI that shows you how much Experience and Rank you gained from each match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32295460/64dbac34cd94276e200074ead00ab25877f1d5fd.jpg[/img]



[h3][b]New Menu - Career Profile[/b][/h3]
This new UI houses some base statistics of your online game career as well as your Exp + Rank for the competitive type matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32295460/0982624ee209ed95ad0b3d7f0a582ee53abd1699.jpg[/img]



[h1][b]Bug Fixes, Optimizations and Quality of life Improvements[/b][/h1]

[b]New:[/b] Leading Player in online now keeps the crown in the Lobby Menu.
[b]New:[/b] Number of wins is now exposed in the Lobby menu.
[b]New:[/b] Added new cinematic for Small Bay Map in the Lobby.
[b]New:[/b] Added new cinematic for Small Bay Map in the Loading Screen.
[b]Patched:[/b] Patched fog effect that was out of place for some resolutions in the Sky Island map.
[b]Patched:[/b] Patched the Main Menu Navigation "Quit" selection that couldn't be selected by gamepad / keyboard previously.
[b]Improved:[/b] Gamepad and Keyboard support.
[b]Improved:[/b] Server and client connectivity simplified resulting in faster gameplay and lower lag,
[b]Improved:[/b]  Updated the pause menu to also include a controller map for easier in-game access.
[b]Improved:[/b] Updated START GAME button color and animation when players are ready for a match
